decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan; 4443_003; 4443_010 Rev.D.; 4443_004; 4443_011 Rev.D.; 4443_006; 4443_013; Design and Access Statement prepared by Llewellyn Harker Lowe Architects; 4443_015 Rev.D.; 4443_005; 4443_014 Rev.D; Document titled "General Maintenance Lightweight Sedum System Bauder XF301 System" prepared by Bauder; 4443_018 Rev.C; Document titled "Bauder Extensive Sedum Substrate" prepared by Bauder; Document titled "Technical Data Sheet Bauder Green SB Sedum Blanket" prepared by Bauder.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policies SD1, SD2, SD4, SD5, and SD6 of the Redington Frognal Neighbourhood Plan 2021.
Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the four new side windows, as labelled on drawing 4443_013, shall be fitted with reeded glass, and the windows shall be retained as such for the duration of the development. 

Reason: To prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with policy A1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The living roof shall be fully provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme. 

Reason: In order to ensure the development undertakes reasonable measures to take account of biodiversity and the water environment in accordance with policies G1, CC1, CC2, D1, D2 and A3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Erection of a replacement single storey rear extension, alterations to front dormer window, replacement of rooflights to side roof and fenestration alterations to rear and side elevations.
